facts.fact: Decreto Executivo 424/25 of the Ministry of Education (18 June 2025) lists a 'Plataforma Informatica de Gestao de Dados de Alunos', defined as the tool that records the pupil's essential information, among the instruments for recording assessment results in primary (art. 23) and secondary general education (art. 26); it gives no usage figure and does not say schools already use it.
